basic_info.description: Welcome to a residence where timeless charm meets modern living. This three-bedroom, two-bathroom home spans approximately 1,738 square feet and offers a blend of comfort and functionality, ideal for both quiet moments and vibrant gatherings. The expansive living area is bathed in natural light, seamlessly flowing into a well-equipped updated kitchen perfect for culinary creativity whether you're crafting gourmet dishes or simply attempting to unlock the mysteries of sourdough. Remodeled Bathrooms and hardwood floors throughtout make this a dream come true.  The home lies within a coveted neighborhood, enjoying proximity to everyday essentials without sacrificing tranquility. Just a short distance away, West Portal area provides convenient access to groceries and dining, while Glen Canyon Park invites you to trade screens for serene outdoor enjoyment and bird songs. Commuting is simple with the nearby Forest Hill Station, and residents will appreciate being just over a mile from Archbishop Riordan High School and St Ignatius School and St Brendans. Surrounded by established greenery and community warmth, this inviting retreat offers both connectivity and calm in one well-positioned package.
